arStrings.szText: Wheezing through sulfur-choked lungs, she marched toward the demonic legionnaire. Stepping over fallen comrade and enemy alike, she drew a long knife out of her bloody calves without a wince. "We both serve a new master now—oblivion," she spat, and shoved the blade through the demon's heart. "You first."
Salute us who fall in your name!
